# Official ITI template provenance

`VPAT-2.5Rev-WCAG.docx` is the unchanged official Information Technology Industry
Council (ITI) VPAT® Version 2.5Rev WCAG edition, April 2025.

- Downloaded 2026-09-10 from https://www.itic.org/dotAsset/67270ffc-91e8-4812-9481-8067621f24fd.docx
- Publisher and terms: https://www.itic.org/policy/accessibility/vpat
- SHA-256: `d9028314001743473e30e9615e2593fb14d56d3a87ee15e7dda17e0d134470a0`

ITI provides the template free of charge; ITI membership is not required. The VPAT
name and report form are registered service marks. The source includes the essential
requirements and best practices for using it; read these before publishing an ACR.
This third-party template is not relicensed under this project's license.

`vpat-template.docx` report downloads retain these exact source bytes, including the
instructions. `draft-acr.docx` copies the report portion of this template, removes the
instruction section, fills metadata and evidence/assessments, and selects only the
requested WCAG version and levels. ITI permits this version/level selection in its
instructions. All selected criteria remain, including criteria with no automated data.
Unreviewed decisions are blank, not automatically Supports. The original template's
prefilled 4.1.1 decision is not mistaken for an attributed reviewer decision.

All original ZIP parts except document.xml and settings.xml are preserved byte-for-byte,
including styles, fonts, relationships, headers, footers and ITI source metadata.
Word fields are flagged for refresh. Generated drafts require human review and a Word
layout/accessibility check before publication. ITI does not certify these outputs.
